_comment: Template for a regional source. Copy this file into config/sources/regional/<region>/ (or into <QGIS profile>/territorial_suite/sources/ to keep it across plugin updates), fill it in, set enabled=true and last_verified to the day you checked the service. Sources shipped with the plugin must have been verified: an unverified descriptor stays disabled.
name: Nome del dataset
notes: Indicare qui i limiti del dato e la differenza fra rappresentazione cartografica e accertamento giuridico.
